|ingredients = [[File:Fish.png|24px|link=]] Any [[Fish]] (1){{Name|Seaweed|1}}{{Name|Rice|1}} }} '''Maki Roll''' is a [[Cooking|cooked dish]]. It is prepared using either the kitchen inside an upgraded [[farmhouse]] or a [[Cookout Kit]]. '''Note:''' This recipe is [[Cooking#Profitable Recipes|profitable]] when using [[Rice]] made in the mill and fish selling below {{Price|100}}. Maki Roll may randomly appear in [[Krobus]]' shop on [[Days of the Week#Saturday|Saturdays]] or in [[the Stardrop Saloon]]'s rotating stock. It can also be found occasionally in the [[Garbage Can]] outside [[The Stardrop Saloon]]. [[Linus]] may randomly send Maki Roll in the mail as a gift. One Maki Roll may be received from opening a [[Mystery Box]]. ==Gifting== {{GiftsByItem |like=Robin,Demetrius,Maru,Sebastian,Linus,Pierre,Caroline,Abigail,Alex,George,Lewis,Clint,Penny,Pam,Haley,Jas,Vincent,Jodi,Sam,Leah,Shane,Marnie,Elliott,Gus,Dwarf,Wizard,Harvey,Sandy,Kent |neutral=Willy |hate=Evelyn,Emily |dislike=Krobus,Leo }} ==Bundles== Maki Roll is used in the {{Bundle|chef||y}}. ==Recipes== Maki Roll is not used in any recipes. ==Tailoring== Maki Roll is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] with [[Cloth]] in the feed to create a {{Name|Shirt037|link=Tailoring{{!}}Shirt|class=inline}}. It is a black dye when used in the spool of the Sewing Machine with a dyeable clothing item in the feed. ==Quests== Maki Roll is not used in any [[Quests|quests]]. ==History== {{History|1.4|Recipe price reduced from {{Price|1500}} to {{Price|300}}.
